Grain Procurement
As one of the area’s top beef cattle feeders, you need reliable resources for feed. Our grain procurement specialists purchase grain and silage for use in the Gottsch Livestock Feeders operations, and always at a fair price.

NOTES FOR PRODUCERS |
• Corn moisture maximum is 18%, and we will shrink at 1.5% back to 15.5% moisture.
No additional cash discounts are taken for corn over 15.5% moisture.
Corn contracts offered:
– Cash Contracts
– Basis Contracts – Bushels delivered at harvest will have a basis locked in, but no futures price.
You can price the futures at any time, but harvest delivered basis corn must be priced by 11/25/26.
– Spring Average Contracts – Gottsch Spring Average contracts will be offered for your your new crop bin bushels or for 2027 new crop bushels.
